source.title: A judge forgot to hold a sheet between the competitor's face and the puzzle (extra not available)
source.content:
A judge forgot to hold a sheet between the competitor's face and the puzzle. This was found after the end of the competition and no extra was granted.

The WRC decided to accept the result as the video showed no sign of the competitor abusing the situation and it was not his fault.

translation.title: 裁判忘记放置遮挡板（无额外尝试）
translation.content:
裁判忘记在选手脸部与魔方之间放置遮挡板。比赛结束后才发现问题，没有给予额外尝试。

WRC 决定接受该成绩，因为视频没有显示选手利用这一情况的迹象，且错误并非由选手造成。
